outcomeNote: a series of aggadic dicta opened by a mnemonic

segments.he: סִימָן: אִשָּׁה. וְקַרְקַע. עֵזֶר. זֹאת. שְׁתֵּי. הַבְרָכוֹת. תַּגָּרֵי. פָּחֲתִי. אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: כׇּל אָדָם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ אִשָּׁה — אֵינוֹ אָדָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בְּרָאָם וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָם אָדָם״. וְאָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: כׇּל אָדָם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ קַרְקַע — אֵינוֹ אָדָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַה׳ וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי אָדָם״.
segments.en: § The Gemara provides «a mnemonic» device for a series of statements cited in the name of Rabbi Elazar: «Woman; and land; helper; this; two; the blessings; merchants; lowly.» The Gemara presents these statements: «Rabbi Elazar said: Any man who does not have a wife is not a man, as it is stated: “Male and female He created them…and called their name Adam”» (Genesis 5:2). «And Rabbi Elazar said: Any man who does not have» his own «land is not a man, as it is stated: “The heavens are the heavens of the Lord; but the earth He has given to the children of men”» (Psalms 115:16).
